items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Jeanette was outstanding, because she was with Papa Celestin... she was just a marvelous pianist, and she was with Papa Celestin's orchestra oh, for quite awhile.

ctx.x: That you can remember the names of.

Offhand I -- isn't it funny, I can't think of any other names right now, but Jeanette was outstanding, because she was with Papa Celestin. Her husband at that time was also with the orchestra. He was a marvelous guitar player.
